fields.name: magic_primary
fields.evidence: FUN_080237a0: '*(S+0x83) = *buf; if (*(S+0x83) == 'W') *(S+0x83) = buf[0x171]'; FUN_080235b4 booleanizes it. Logical offset 0 maps to file offset 0x007 under FUN_08049504's per-block byte reversal; both .sav files hold 0x57 there.

fields.name: payload_first_byte_suspected_version
fields.evidence: Observed 0x32 in both saves; FUN_080234b0 '*puVar1 = 0x32' (u16) in ghidra/decompiled.c. No code in the corpus reads or compares this byte, so a checked version tag is unproven; a stat value of 50 is equally consistent.

fields.name: payload_body_opaque
fields.evidence: FUN_080237a0 'func_0x08049a9c(_DAT_08023804, param_1 + 1, 0x170)' in ghidra/decompiled.c; byte census computed from both .sav files after block-reversal transform. RAM destination literal unresolved, hence ram_addr null.

fields.name: payload_flag_a
fields.evidence: One of only seven non-0x00/0xFF payload bytes in either save (Python byte census); boolean-like value 0x01.

fields.name: payload_flag_pair_b
fields.evidence: Adjacent 0x01 pair; payload-relative offset 0x00C, and the three pairs at payload offsets 0x00C/0x060/0x0B4 are exactly 0x54 apart, matching FUN_080234b0's 3-entry x 0x54-byte stride.

fields.name: payload_flag_pair_c
fields.evidence: Adjacent 0x01 pair exactly 0x54 after payload_flag_pair_b; see FUN_080234b0 stride analysis.

fields.name: payload_flag_pair_d
fields.evidence: Adjacent 0x01 pair exactly 0x54 after payload_flag_pair_c; see FUN_080234b0 stride analysis.

fields.name: payload_erased_looking_region
fields.evidence: Both .sav files hold 0xFF across logical 0x150..0x16F even though sav-01 is fully written and checksum-valid; therefore payload data (reserved space or 0xFF/-1 sentinel fields), not unwritten media.

fields.name: magic_secondary
fields.evidence: FUN_080237a0 'if (*(char *)(_DAT_08023800 + 0x83) == 'W') *(char *)(_DAT_08023800 + 0x83) = param_1[0x171]'; sav-01 holds 0x57 at the transformed file offset, sav-00 still holds erased 0xFF.

fields.name: checksum_sum8
fields.evidence: FUN_080237a0 sum loop + 'if (param_1[0x172] == cVar3)'; Python verification executed on both .sav files (see SAVE-FORMAT-REPORT.md section 4.3): sav-01 computed 0x60 == stored 0x60; naive file-order sum gives 0x61, independently confirming the block-reversal transform.

fields.name: image_tail_zero_filled
fields.evidence: Byte census of both .sav files; FUN_080237a0 reads at most logical 0x172 and FUN_080235b4 validates nothing beyond it. The sav-00->sav-01 0xFF->0x00 transition over this range is the clearest block-ascending write-progress marker.
